descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione

L'azienda familiare svizzera, fondata nel 1836, è oggi una delle aziende dolciarie più rinomate d'Europa grazie al suo assortimento selezionato. I prodotti della casa Sprüngli sono sinonimo di massima qualità, freschezza unica e naturalezza. Le creazioni raffinate entusiasmano ogni giorno clienti da tutto il mondo.

Addetto/a al servizio (80-100%) Paradeplatz, Zurigo

80% - 100%, Zurigo

Lavorare presso Sprüngli

Nel 2018, la Confiserie Sprüngli è stata premiata nella classifica svizzera del Choco Guide con il 1. posto come miglior caffè, secondo i criteri di valutazione di ambiente, servizio, qualità, offerta, freschezza e innovazione. Vuoi anche tu far parte dei migliori e dare ogni giorno il tuo prezioso contributo? Coccoliamo i nostri ospiti in Paradeplatz nel tradizionale caffè-ristorante inaugurato nel 1859 al primo piano oppure nel moderno caffè-bar al piano terra, nonché nel Café & Lounge all'aeroporto di Zurigo.

Per i nostri esercizi di ristorazione in Paradeplatz cerchiamo con effetto immediato o da concordare un/a addetto/a al servizio.

Cosa farai da noi

Ami l'atmosfera vivace di Paradeplatz a Zurigo? Ti piace coccolare i tuoi ospiti con prodotti di prima qualità, incantarli con il tuo sorriso e distinguerti per il tuo aspetto curato? Cordialità, rapidità e rispetto degli standard di servizio sono per te scontati? Allora è arrivato il momento di conoscerti.

Tra le tue mansioni rientrano:

- Servizio e consulenza alla nostra clientela nazionale e internazionale (in parte con gestione degli incassi)
- Preparazione e servizio delle nostre diverse specialità di caffè e cioccolato
- Rispetto delle norme igieniche nonché lavori generali di riordino e pulizia

Cosa desideriamo

- Formazione completata come addetta/o alla ristorazione EFZ
- Spiccato orientamento al servizio e piacere di lavorare in un ambiente dinamico con clientela internazionale
- Aspetto curato e buone maniere
- Capacità di lavorare in team e metodo di lavoro rapido e accurato
- Parli correntemente tedesco e inglese; la conoscenza di altre lingue straniere costituisce un vantaggio
- Elevata flessibilità per quanto riguarda gli orari di lavoro (turni tra le 6.00 e le 19.30 in un'attività operativa 7 giorni alla settimana)

Cosa ti aspetta

- Ti offriamo un'attività varia in una sede vivace e in un ambiente curato, un ristorante per il personale e sconti sugli acquisti.

Contatto

Sei interessato/a?
Allora saremo lieti di ricevere la tua candidatura elettronica.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Description

The Swiss family-owned company, founded in 1836, is now one of Europe’s most renowned confectioneries with its exquisite range. The products from Sprüngli stand for the finest quality, unique freshness and naturalness. The perfected creations delight customers from all over the world every day.

Service staff member (80-100%) Paradeplatz Zurich

80% - 100%, Zurich

Working at Sprüngli

In 2018, Confiserie Sprüngli was awarded 1st place for the best café in the nationwide Swiss ranking by the Choco Guide, based on the criteria of ambience, service, quality, selection, freshness and innovation. Would you also like to be among the best and make your valuable contribution every day? We pamper our guests at Paradeplatz in the traditional café-restaurant opened in 1859 on the first floor, in the modern café-bar on the ground floor, and in the Café & Lounge at Zurich Airport.

For our food service operations at Paradeplatz, we are looking for a service staff member to start immediately or by agreement.

What you will do with us

Do you love the vibrant atmosphere at Paradeplatz Zurich? Do you enjoy treating your guests to the finest products, enchanting them with your smile and impressing them with your well-groomed appearance? Are friendliness, efficiency and compliance with service standards a matter of course for you? Then it is time for us to get to know you.

Your responsibilities include:

- Serving and advising our national and international customers (including cash handling in some cases)
- Preparation and service of our various coffee & chocolate specialties
- Compliance with hygiene regulations as well as general tidying and cleaning work

What we are looking for

- Completed training as a restaurant specialist EFZ
- High level of service orientation and enjoyment of working in a lively establishment with an international clientele
- Well-groomed appearance and good manners
- A team-oriented, efficient and conscientious approach to work
- You speak fluent German and English; additional foreign languages are an advantage
- High flexibility with regard to working hours (shifts between 6.00 and 19.30 in a 7-day operation)

Here’s what you can look forward to

- We offer you a varied role at a vibrant location in a well-maintained environment, an employee restaurant and shopping discounts.

Contact

Are you interested?
Then we look forward to receiving your electronic application.

• Trägst aktiv zur wirtschaftlichen Weiterentwicklung unseres Unternehmens bei

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im kaufmännischen Bereich (EFZ)

• Minimum 10 Jahren Berufserfahrung im Controlling inkl. Weiterbildung im Controllingbereich

• Zwingend: Erfahrung im Werkscontrolling

• Du bist stark im Umgang mit den Office-Programmen und kannst deinen Aufgabenbereich eigenverantwortlich organisieren

• Sehr gute SAP-Kenntnisse (insbesondere S/4 Hana)

• Affinität für Zahlen und ausgeprägtes strategisches Denkvermögen

• Starke Excel Kenntnisse

• Du schätzt und förderst die Zusammenarbeit mit weiteren internen Stellen

• Selbständige, gut strukturierte und engagierte Arbeitsweise auch in intensiven Phasen

• Stilsichere Deutschkenntnisse in Schrift und Sprache

Responsable du contrôle (70-100%)

80% - 100%, Dietikon

Travailler chez Sprüngli

Vous cherchez un nouveau défi professionnel dans lequel vous pouvez utiliser à la fois votre expérience de leadership et votre passion et êtes un talent organisationnel structuré avec un style de données? Nous attendons avec impatience votre candidature.
Dans notre fabricant à Dietikon, nous sommes à la recherche d'un service de contrôle expérimenté, motivé et engagé dès maintenant ou par accord. *n

Ce que tu fais avec nous

Dans notre service Contrôle, vous dirigez notre équipe de Contrôle de trois personnes et êtes responsable de la gestion financière de l'entreprise – dans le but de créer la transparence, de permettre des décisions éclairées et de façonner activement le succès durable de l'entreprise.

• Dirigez et développez notre équipe de contrôle de trois personnes

• Responsable du contrôle opérationnel et stratégique

• Créer des budgets, des prévisions et des états financiers mensuels et annuels

• Analyser les chiffres clés et formuler des recommandations d'action judicieuses

• Conseiller la direction en tant que partenaire compétent

• Optimise les processus de contrôle et développe les instruments de rapport

• contribue activement au développement économique de notre entreprise

• Vous apportez de nouvelles idées et agissez activement dans votre rôle

Ce que nous voulons

• Formation commerciale terminée (EFZ)

• Au moins 10 ans d'expérience professionnelle dans le contrôle incl. Enseignement supérieur dans le domaine du contrôle

• Vous avez déjà une expérience en leadership et avez déjà terminé une formation en leadership

• Expérience en contrôle d'usine

• Vous êtes fort dans le traitement des programmes de bureau et pouvez organiser votre secteur de travail indépendamment

• Très bonne connaissance SAP (en particulier S/4 Hana)

• Affinité pour les chiffres et forte pensée stratégique

• Forte connaissance Excel

• Vous appréciez et encouragez la coopération avec d'autres organes internes

• Méthode de travail indépendante, bien structurée et engagée également en phases intensives

• Personnalité ouverte, fiable et communicative avec une compréhension rapide

• Style-confident connaissance de l'allemand dans l'écriture et la langue

• La connaissance de l'industrie alimentaire est un avantage

• Personnalité analytique et entrepreneuriale avec un mode de travail structuré et orienté vers la solution

Vous pouvez attendre avec impatience.

Un lieu de travail moderne et lumineux vous attend dans une atmosphère traditionnelle avec une bonne ambiance de travail et dans une équipe motivée. Nous sommes heureux de prendre soin des vêtements de travail et de leur nettoyage. Nous vous offrons de bonnes conditions d'emploi telles que 5 semaines de vacances, un jour de congé supplémentaire dans le mois d'anniversaire, un parking gratuit et de généreuses réductions d'achat. Il y a la possibilité d'un bureau à domicile jour par semaine.

Ça t'intéresse ?
Ensuite, nous attendons avec impatience votre application électronique. *
Nous n'acceptons pas actuellement les candidatures des agences de recrutement pour ce poste.

Production employee*in machine operation 100% / Luxemburgerli department

100%, Dietikon

Working at Sprüngli

In our factory in Dietikon we are looking for an experienced, motivated and committed person for the Luxemburgerli department immediately or by appointment

What you do with us

You will work in our Luxemburgerli department in our factory in Dietikon and support the team in producing our outstanding and popular Luxemburgerli. Your working hours are between 4 a.m. and 4 p.m. and take place between Monday and Friday. Due to the season, operations must be possible on Saturday.

Your tasks:

• Production of our leading product Luxemburgerli as a team

• Production of various fillings, jellies, creams and egg white masses

• Setup, preparation and operation of production machines

• Grinding and grating the various nuts

• Compliance and control of safety, hygiene and quality requirements

What we wish for

• Worked for several years in a food processing position

• A good understanding of machine controls, ideally initial experience with PLCs, as well as knowledge of operating systems

• A precise, quality-conscious and independent way of working as well as resilience even in intensive situations

• Mobility and flexibility

• with manual skills and a good physical condition

• PC knowledge (MS Office) is an advantage

• Good knowledge of German

• Willingness for shift work

You can look forward to that

With us you can expect a diverse and challenging range of tasks in a lively, modern environment. You work in a motivated team with an open “you” culture and real cohesion.

• ✨ 10 minutes paid changing time

• 👕 Work clothing including cleaning

• 🎂An extra day off in your birthday month

• 🏖️ 5 weeks vacation

• 🚗 Free parking space

• 🛍️ Generous shopping discounts

• 🥗 Meals available on site

🛡️ Strong social benefits:
– The employer voluntarily covers the full premium for daily sickness benefit insurance
– The costs of occupational accident insurance in accordance with the UVG are borne entirely by the employer

Are you interested?
Then we look forward to receiving your electronic application.*
We are currently not accepting applications from employment agencies for this position.
